title: v1.13.0 Release Execution (Games 15 & 16 + Perf/Bundle Hardening)
summary: Ship Game 15 (Color Match), Game 16 (Add It Up), and Performance & Bundle Hardening as v1.13.0 via the standard release process (release branch + version bump 1.12.0 → 1.13.0, release notes, device-testing checklist Game 15/16 rows, five quality gates incl. validate-bundle, annotated tag + PR → master, tag-gated Coolify deploy, live smoke, user-led async device testing). Parent Progress Insights is explicitly out of scope (ships later as v1.14.0).
